provenance: New hand-authored synthetic projects held out from cutoff calibration, labelled before any score collection. Includes Python and JavaScript, code-only negatives and a paraphrased callee rationale. Not independently labelled real-session effectiveness data.

memories.title: Batch transport agreement
memories.body: The upstream rejects envelopes containing more than two hundred and fifty records.

memories.title: Continuation interoperability
memories.body: Older consumers interpret the continuation marker as an opaque string.

queries.question: Which constraint should a change to page_size preserve?
queries.rationale: The upstream envelope limit constrains the page size, whereas cursor representation does not.

queries.question: Why does page_size stop at 250?
queries.rationale: The upstream contract explains the bound.

queries.question: What does page_size(600) return?
queries.rationale: Current source supplies the numeric answer without historical notes.

queries.question: What upstream contract governs the number of records in a batch?
queries.rationale: Only the envelope capacity contract answers the question.

memories.title: Delivery expiration
memories.body: The receiver retires an unacknowledged delivery after three quarters of a minute. Longer waits lose the pending notification.

memories.title: Envelope compatibility
memories.body: Downstream decoders require the original field sequence in serialized messages.

memories.title: Diagnostic sampling
memories.body: Emit tracing events for one percent of invocations.

queries.question: Which constraints govern sendEvent retry timing?
queries.rationale: The decision attached to the callee bounds the waiting interval; serialization and tracing do not.

queries.question: Why does sendEvent stop increasing the pause after forty-five seconds?
queries.rationale: The receiver lifetime explains the cap despite using different wording.

queries.question: What value does retryPause(2) return?
queries.rationale: The result is directly calculable from source.

queries.question: What does eventKey(7) return?
queries.rationale: String conversion needs no historical tracing or transport decisions.
